changes.title: Who is Andy Burnham, the man becoming Britain's next prime minister?
changes.summary: The man replacing U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer is Andy Burnham, known as the "King of the North.".

changes.title: Andy Burnham is declared leader of UK's Labour Party, pledges to restore hope
changes.summary: The former mayor of Greater Manchester was the only contender in the center-left party's leadership contest to replace departing Prime Minister Keir Starmer, who was forced out by a rebellion within his party.
